newsitem.title: GERMANY: German 1997 grain crop to exceed 1996 - Toepfer.
newsitem.headline: German 1997 grain crop to exceed 1996 - Toepfer.

text.p: Germany's 1997 grain crop is very likely to exceed the 1996 result of 42.1 million tonnes, assuming steady weather patterns, grain trader Alfred C Toepfer said in a monthly newsletter.
The report said farmers expanded winter wheat sowings by four percent and winter barley sowings by seven percent while the area planted to triticale in the winter was expanded by nearly a third.
Spring barley plantings should be expanded by one percent while the oats area should fall by one percent.
Spring plantings this year had started two or three weeks earlier than in an average season, aided by favourable weather, Toepfer said.
Conditions were currently ideal for both winter and spring crops.
